title: Upgrade: v1.10.1-sdk-bloat
summary:
Removes unused Cosmos SDK modules to reduce binary size and attack surface.

Removed modules:
- authz (permission delegation)
- feegrant (fee payment delegation)
- group (on-chain DAO/multisig)
- epochs (scheduled hooks)
- mint (SDK inflation minting - we use custom minting via core module)
- circuit (emergency shutdown)
- evidence (double-sign evidence)

This upgrade deletes the KV stores for these modules. The chain will fail to start if validators run the new binary before the upgrade height.

BINARY REQUIREMENT: All validators must update to v1.10.1 binary BEFORE the upgrade height.
